Export `RegistrationFields` with string properties `contact`, `organization`, `role`, `givenName`, `familyName`, and `summary`, plus `attachment: { name: string }`; export `RegistrationErrors` as the same field keys mapped to `string | null`; and export `RegistrationResult { valid: boolean; errors: RegistrationErrors }`. Return every error key every time, using `null` for valid fields and a concise non-null message otherwise. `valid` is true only when all errors are null. Do not mutate the input and use no external packages.
